spec_match.rationale: Teaches the exact changed contract: requireInteraction remains in the API (probed on the prototype and reflected on instances) but becomes advisory for attributed macOS app notifications, where per-app System Settings decide persistence — matching the chromestatus description and WebKit alignment.

interactive.rationale: Checkbox + fire button constructs real notifications with the chosen flag; show/close/error events all reported; permission requestable in-page.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the surface probe plus honest manual-observation framing; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: The probe-can't-lie problem is addressed head-on: the page states that no API reads back the OS display style, so persistence is labelled a manual observation per context (tab honors it, attributed app ignores it) — never a fake behavioral pass. Refusals, close events, and constructor throws all surfaced.

references.rationale: Feature index cites the chromestatus entry and Notifications spec; the contract panel names the exact per-context outcomes.

conformance.rationale: The suite's notification-surface and requireinteraction-reflects-request assertions cover this page's probeable half.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: surface probe reported 'requireInteraction' in Notification.prototype = true with permission 'default'; firing with the flag checked reported the real not-granted refusal (no simulated success). Zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: notifattr-ri-fired asserts when a notification actually fires, with the reflected value.

design_system.rationale: Contract panel on paper, mono status blocks on stone; CSS variables only; 1.3rem checkbox target.

accessibility.rationale: Probe and outcome are role=status live regions; checkbox properly labelled with the code term; native controls throughout.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Single-column panels, wrapping rows; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Record the divergence pair on real hardware
openQuestions.detail: Two manual observations complete this page: a granted browser-tab run where requireInteraction:true visibly persists, and an attributed macOS app run where the same call shows as a transient banner (per-app settings winning). Capture both.

guidanceConsulted.query: request permission on user gesture explain before prompt
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Permission prompts only from explicit user action.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Dedicated request button; fire button never triggers a prompt itself, it reports the refusal.
All outcomes (refusal, show, close, platform error, constructor throw) land in the role=status region.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the probeable half is measured for real (member present, permission state honest, refusal surfaced) and the unprobeable half — OS persistence behavior — is explicitly framed as manual observation per context rather than faked, which is the entire lesson of this change.
